[SWS_SM_CONSTR_00022] Existence of StateMachine VerifyUpdate state
⌈
Each
configured
StateMachine
shall have corresponding
VerifyUpdate StateMa-
chine State
configured, at the time when the creation of the manifest is finished.
⌋
Before starting verification, it is needed to block
RequestTransition
method - when
not already done.
As the next step, transition of all affected
StateMachines
to the
VerifyUpdate
state is needed. When identifying which
StateMachines
are affected, the list that
Update and Configuration Management
supplies as a parameter to the
Veri-
fyUpdate
method can be used.
